remarks: Perfect as an Investment or as a Multi-Generational Opportunity Discover the potential of this well-maintained two-family home, set on 0.20 acres and perched high on Moshier Street. Each unit features two generously sized bedrooms, one bathroom, and a family room. The lower level includes a private entrance, an additional bathroom, and a kitchen area-ideal for extended family or as potential rental income. Enjoy ample parking with a detached two-car garage and additional off-street spaces. The rear of the property borders Pemberwick Park and a scenic nature preserve, offering both sports courts, playgrounds, and walking trails. Close to transit including Metro North stations, the Merritt Parkway, and Westchester County Airport. Two minutes to the Mill and downtown Glenville. Districted for Glenville Elementary School, taxes are under $6,200 a year, and there is plenty of FAR remaining.
